name: Image Compressor WebP by htmlrunner
author: htmlrunner

sections.description:
Image Compressor WebP by htmlrunner converts JPEG and PNG images to WebP format for reduced file sizes with no quality loss.

Fast Compression with Full Privacy

All processing happens on your server. Images are never sent to external services. Your data remains private and secure without any subscriptions.

Features

  • Fast compression: Converts images to WebP format efficiently.
  • No quality loss: Maintains visual quality while reducing file size.
  • Bulk actions: Convert multiple images or your entire library at once.
  • Quality settings: Adjustable compression level via settings page.
  • Local processing: All conversions performed on your hosting server.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the wp-media-to-webp folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress.
  3. Go to the Webp Converter menu in your dashboard.
  4. Select images and click “Convert”.
sections.faq:
Is my data safe?

Absolutely. The conversion process happens entirely on your hosting server. We do not have access to your images, and they are never uploaded to any external cloud service.

Does this require a subscription?

No. Since the plugin uses your server’s local PHP GD or Imagick library, you don’t need to pay for external API credits.

Does this delete my original images?

Yes, to save server space, this plugin replaces the original file with the WebP version.
